The agent's final message is the report `/essentials:review` printed for a test project. Paths in it are relative to the project root, and a report may cite a file by path, by `path:line`, or by its type or directory name.

PASS if the report names the stack contract's frontend checks (s8-*, s11-skip-frontend) as not run (under a 'Not run' heading or an equivalent statement).
Why: The fixture has no frontend, so stack-lint.py lists the S8 frontend checks and s11-skip-frontend in its notRun with the reason "no frontend"; the report names them under Not run, as a group or one by one.
FAIL if the report omits it, calls those checks clean or passed, or reports findings from them anyway.
